question: In a certain code language, ‘AROUND’ is written as ‘PSBFPW’ and 'ARTIST' is written as 'USBVUK'. How will ‘AUTHOR’ be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First three letters ⇒ (1) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally .
 
• Last three letter ⇒ (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally.

So, 

 
• ‘AROUND’ is written as ‘PSBFPW’

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9152d2149b76eaed9efaf36e2a6dad9edd10c5d5a9864fb9b529b2d41539c2da.png] 

​And,

 
• 'ARTIST' is written as 'USBVUK'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c1418531d51a3c3661a8de50da6716c6daba5d46ad82da2b96660ef045deb79.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c439757b0546078aa8403705673bde49725a002930a60378d5c5f8f80a1b7e9f.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘AUTHOR’ is written as:

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e71ddac3dc926678e59efd25ba410a4050eac6a034be06f452faa579c8118775.png] 

​Hence, "**UVBTQJ**" is the correct answer.
